[[File:FavoritesoftheForce.png|thumb|250px|Favorites of the Force]]
'''Favorites of the Force''' was a sour oval-shaped candy of various [[Color/Legends|colors]] (red, yellow, green, orange, and blue) and shapes (both small and large) created by secretive confectioners for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was sold by a Rebel Alliance officer during the [[Remembrance Day]] celebrations in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Its packaging had red, yellow, and green stripes (with red and green being most prominent) and featured the likeness of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].
